description: List the composable iDos Games game modules in the catalog — the same registry the local @idosgames/mcp server serves. Each entry has id, name, type (template = a complete ready-to-run game to start FROM, e.g. voxelcraft; feature = a system to add on top, e.g. store, quests, leaderboard), engine, genre, a short summary, what it 'provides' (its features), tags, preview media, a live demo url, 'inBase' (installed with the base in every new project), 'uses' (modules a game needs) and 'events' (topics it emits and listens to). Read 'provides' to reuse a ready module instead of building the feature from scratch, then get_module to pull its source. Read-only; takes no title_id.
name: list_modules
title: List game modules
